study_roles.rationale: All 100 development seeds were consumed for coefficient fitting and diagnostics; the draft records only their namespace and committed list digest.
A development unit test materialized a prefix from this namespace. No scenario result used it, but it is no longer eligible to serve as untouched evidence.
A development unit test materialized a prefix from this namespace. No scenario result used it, but it is no longer eligible to serve as untouched evidence.
The base integration study selects no policy or operating point. This replacement namespace remains reserved and inaccessible unless a later approved selection protocol needs it.
One hundred mission seeds support the approved deterministic integration gate and descriptive mission-cluster intervals without making a policy-effectiveness claim.
A confirmatory namespace and count require separately approved policy endpoints, margins, multiplicity, power, and workflow. This base integration draft does not create them.

seed_derivation_procedure: After approval only: hash UTF-8 WF-DFLD-01-REFERENCE|{role}-v2|{index} with SHA-256, read the first four bytes big-endian, apply bitmask 0x7fffffff, and reject any collision. The draft performs none of these operations.

exact_gates.requirement: All eight approved causal axes preserve keyed common random numbers and their declared upstream invariants.
Runtime, memory, and transient output remain within the frozen ceilings in the exact registered environment.
Event, evidence, TRACE, commitment, authorization, outcome, revision, and compensation chains verify exactly.
Resources, crews, actions, commitments, outcomes, and strict capacity accounting satisfy all conservation invariants.
Generation, runtime continuation, replay, and deterministic publication reproduce every registered byte.
The registered fault profile exercises every declared fault family, with no silent exclusion of an unreachable family.
Online components and public outputs never read or expose hidden truth or lineage; deletion leaves public decisions unchanged.
Registered crash and retry points preserve uninterrupted-versus-restarted durable and public continuation equivalence.
Every protected Small artifact and digest remains byte-identical to its approved baseline.
Scientific inputs, source licenses, safe-path boundaries, offline execution, and complete provenance all verify.

report_only_estimands.method: Mission-cluster means and intervals reported separately for allocation, refusal, HOLD, BLOCK, and ESCALATE.
Mission-level completed, active, partial, failed, and unknown service counts with explicit scenario censoring.
Mission-level stale execution, consistency debt, validity slack, guard status, and audit attribution summaries.
Incident coverage and report coverage are summarized separately with mission-cluster intervals.
Verification channels, evidence age, latency, and cost are summarized without an efficacy comparison.
Strict finite load and unserviceable windows are reported for canonical kappa=1 and paired kappa=0.5; no ratio is targeted.
Pairwise identity, false-merge, missed-link, false-report, revision, and dispute summaries use hidden truth only after runtime.
Detection, affected-set, compensation, retry, restoration, and residual-debt summaries are reported by fault family.
Crossing state, reachability, route failure, travel, and authority activation delays are reported descriptively.
Resource and crew utilization, arrival, service, and completion distributions use seed-cluster summaries.

precision_rationale.interpretation: Using only the 100 spent development missions, 100 validation missions project a normal-approximation 95% half-width of about 24.14 reports for the evaluation-total mean and 1.28 reports/hour for the per-mission breach-phase hourly mean. If no exact-gate failure is observed, the exact one-sided binomial upper bound is about 2.95%; this is a sampling statement, not an operational reliability guarantee.
